svg.title: Three checks of the requests to GitHub
svg.desc: The GraphQL documents of issue_assistant.py meet a copy of GitHub's schema in the required check of every pull request. The commands sweep, sync-labels and context run against GitHub itself with a token that can only read, on every pull request, on main and every week. Every week the documents also meet the schema that GitHub publishes that day, and a notice says when the copy is behind it.
